title: provisioning entry drift
question: When is a restricted-data cloud workspace allowed to enter service, and what state should follow detected drift or lost ownership?
scenario: New analytics workspace: A data science team requests a cloud workspace to process restricted customer data.
focalRelation: Request, purpose, owner, classification, inventory, approved baseline, access, secrets, validation, and acceptance are entry gates; drift or change triggers remediation, reauthorization, isolation, reclassification, or retirement.

nodes.label: Owned, classified request
nodes.detail: The workspace request names its owner, purpose, data classification, dependencies, access model, support period, and expiry.

nodes.label: Approved secure template
nodes.detail: The platform instantiates managed logging, encryption, access, network, backup, and update defaults from the current baseline.

nodes.label: Validation and authorization gate
nodes.detail: The activation gate checks ownership, classification, inventory, baseline configuration, access, dependencies, and evidence before operation or reauthorization.

nodes.label: Authorized operating state
nodes.detail: The workspace runs only for its approved purpose, owner, data, support, monitoring, and expiry conditions.

nodes.label: Drift or purpose change
nodes.detail: A changed setting, owner, support status, data class, or purpose moves the workspace out of its accepted state.

nodes.label: Remediate, isolate, reauthorize, or retire
nodes.detail: The accountable owner chooses a governed transition and records closure rather than leaving the asset silently out of baseline.

treatmentDispositions.rationale: The state model gates a restricted-data workspace from owned classified request through approved template, validation, authorization, and operation. Drift or lost ownership moves the asset to remediation, isolation, reauthorization, or retirement rather than leaving it silently active.

learningJob.plainExplanation: A resource may enter service only after an owned request, approved baseline, validation, and authorization. Drift or an expired exception moves it to remediation, isolation, reauthorization, or retirement before renewed operation.
learningJob.visualReasoningGain: A state machine adds visible allowed transitions and prevents initial approval from looking permanent; the revealed loop does this better than the skeletal opening.
